subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Specific
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3. i.e. Random.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Specific (विशिष्ट) **- Clearly defined or identified.

 
 
• **Example: **She gave him very specific instructions on how to get there.
 
 
 
• **Random (अनियमित)** - Made, done, happening, or chosen without method or conscious decision.
 
 
• **Example:** Winners were selected at random.
 
 
 
• From the above example it is clear that Random is opposite to Specific.

Therefore, the correct answer is- Random.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Topple (गिराना)** - Overbalance or cause to overbalance and fall.

 
 
• **Example:** The vase toppled off the shelf.
 
 
 
• **Lawful (कानूनी) **- Conforming to, permitted by, or recognized by law or rules.
 
 
• **Example: **They demanded the lawful right to hold meetings.
 
 
 
• **Stroll (टहलना) **- Walk in a leisurely way.
 
 
• **Example:** They strolled through the park.
